niche: Mind Hacks, AI Secrets, Bizarre Body Science & Hidden Power Dynamics

ideas.title: The AI Pupil Response Trap
ideas.angle: Explain how AI video software now detects subtle pupil dilations to determine your 'honesty score' in remote interviews or bank loan apps. Viewers are challenged to keep their eyes still while an on-screen stimulus changes, leading to massive engagement in the comments about their 'score'.

hook.en: Stop blinking. AI is watching your pupils.

ideas.reason: AI biometric surveillance is a high-velocity fear/curiosity topic. Current software like HireVue and similar AI platforms use 'micro-expression' analysis, making this a timely and urgent 'survival' secret.
sources: MIT Technology Review on Emotion AI
Biometric data analysis in remote hiring research

ideas.title: The Keyboard Acoustic Spy Secret
ideas.angle: Reveal that AI can now identify your passwords just by 'listening' to the sound of your typing through a laptop microphone or phone. It demonstrates how different keys have unique acoustic signatures. It forces users to comment with their 'laptop model' to see if they are at risk.

hook.en: AI can hear your password right now.

ideas.reason: A recent study from Cornell University showed AI can identify keystrokes with 95% accuracy via microphone. This 'forbidden' tech secret triggers the digital survival pillar and high VVSA.
sources: Cornell University arXiv study on acoustic side-channel attacks
IEEE European Symposium on Security and Privacy

ideas.title: The 3-Second Clipboard Privacy Test
ideas.angle: An interactive challenge where viewers are told to 'Copy any text right now' and then shown how hidden website scripts can scrape their clipboard without a click. It teaches a 'survival' habit of clearing the clipboard and triggers people to type 'safe' in the comments once they clear it.

hook.en: Copy this text to save your data.

ideas.reason: Interactive 'live' tests have the highest retention. Privacy 'leaks' are evergreen viral triggers. Explaining 'Pastejacking' or clipboard hijacking is high-value and slightly terrifying, driving shares.
